## Offline editor practice
Run this path to get five fictional supplies. No login, HTTP request or participant key is needed. It cannot start the ranked clock.

Exercise: keep in_stock = true. Count the remaining SKUs and sum quantity. Build your own native nodes after Split practice supplies.

Expected practice outputs: **available_skus = 3**, **available_quantity = 26**.

This file supplies setup and sample input, not a completed calculation.

## Separate from ranked C07
This stock exercise has different fields, values and rules. It has no parcel history, scan order, desk or personal variant. Practice values are not ranked answers.

When ready, use the separate ranked starter. Its /data request issues your personal assignment and starts the original timer.

Native setup can be reused, but this practice file contains no ranked selection or aggregation solution. Different data cannot guarantee that a general workflow is impossible to copy.
